systems.name: KotlinBottools
systems.function: A Kotlin Discord bot framework on JDA: hierarchical text and slash commands, XML-backed guild and member data, event responders and polling services, built by one Gradle build at 7.5-SNAPSHOT.

systems.name: Toolchain
systems.function: Install, verify and pin every tool, and prove each check is not blind before it is trusted.

plannedBy.placement: WS/tools and the user-scheme pip install, outside every repository

systems.name: Backups and manifests
systems.function: Take one untouched mirror per repository and derive from it everything the rewrite is judged against.

plannedBy.placement: WS/backup and DATA/manifests, outside every repository

systems.name: Legacy data copy
systems.function: Preserve BotData.xml and guildData/ byte-exactly from three revisions before anything is rewritten.

systems.name: Rewrite pipeline
systems.function: Turn one backup-mirrored repository into a pushed, proven, rewritten repository, or stop before its push.

plannedBy.placement: WS/mirror, WS/fresh and DATA/rewrite, outside every repository

systems.name: Privacy gate and id-reference check
systems.function: Prove, by count, that nothing that becomes public with KotlinBottools names a guild, a member or a legacy id, and that nothing new cites a pre-rewrite id.

plannedBy.placement: WS/tools and DATA/run/gate, outside every repository

systems.name: Residual-exposure measurement
systems.function: Measure what GitHub still serves of each old history and report it in counts.

systems.name: Cleanup
systems.function: Leave the machine with the data folder and records, the two realigned clones, and nothing else of the phase.

plannedBy.placement: WS and DATA, outside every repository

systems.name: Repository swap
systems.function: Make the rewritten KotlinBottools public as a fresh repository without losing a number or a link.

systems.name: Clone realignment
systems.function: Bring this working directory onto the rewritten history in place, so that no push from it can carry old history, and replace the TrumpBot clone with a fresh one at the same path.

plannedBy.placement: this working directory, the local TrumpBot clone and DATA/run/realign

systems.name: Repository hygiene
systems.function: Author the in-repo files and the README and changelog edits that land on main through their unit's pull request: a root-anchored .gitignore, .gitleaks.toml, and the secret-scan workflow with its scan wrapper.
